Authentication and session logic in this repo:

- tests/fixtures/simple-node-app/src/auth/login.ts — login handler and user authentication entry point
- tests/fixtures/simple-node-app/src/auth/session.ts — session validation and user session storage
- tests/fixtures/monorepo-app/packages/api/src/auth.controller.ts — API authentication controller with login/logout handlers
- tests/fixtures/monorepo-app/packages/api/src/session.service.ts — SessionService for backend session management
- tests/fixtures/monorepo-app/apps/web/src/LoginPage.tsx — frontend login page component

Why each matters:
- login.ts handles authentication and login flow for the simple app fixture.
- session.ts implements user session logic and session validation.
- auth.controller.ts exposes API endpoints for authentication.
- session.service.ts centralizes session behavior on the API side.
- LoginPage.tsx is the frontend entry point for login.
